title: dashboard live section could show a wrong state: polling stopped at any 'FINAL', void-day banner ignored the pick result, a final+preview double showed Final
tier_reason: dashboard display only; picks, delivery and grading were unaffected

contract.text: The dashboard's live game section keeps refreshing until every pick game is final, and its resolved banner reflects the pick's recorded result, including void slots.

mechanism.text: the dashboard's polling script stopped its refresh timer as soon as the fetched HTML contained 'FINAL' anywhere, so on a cross-game double the section could freeze while the other game was still live
the resolved scorecard banner did not use the pick file's result for partial or full void days (void slot results introduced the same evening by a142c14)
merge_scorecards ranked Final above Preview, so a double whose first game was final and second not started was shown as Final; a null slot_results key also broke the banner lookup

watchdog.trigger: display-only dashboard rendering; no delivery, entry, grading, restart or preservation boundary is involved
